narr: Southwest flow over a moist and diurnally unstable airmass with slow storm motion produced flash flooding where boundaries merged along sea breezes and outflows in the afternoon across the Jacksonville downtown area.
ev: At 3:50 pm, a spotter reported streets and lawns flooded near Lem | Turner Rd. At 4 pm, the public reported streets were flooded in the downtown | Jacksonville area, at least ankle deep in | some spots. At 4:15 pm, the public reported two cars stalled in a flooded road. At 4:30 pm, social media reported showed widespread street | flooding in San Marco near Riviera Street, Landon Ave, Larue Ave, | LaSalle Street, and Belmonte Ave. Portions of Larue Ave and LaSalle St were closed due to flooding. Water covered lawns and nearly entered homes in | some locations.
